$comment: M7 extraction schema, schema_version 1 (ADR-0048). One record per 30 s grid window (ADR-0045); the same shape holds human gold labels and model output. Two identical copies: backend/src/insightex/extract/extraction.schema.json and tools/label_concepts/extraction.schema.json (a test keeps them byte-identical). Rules a JSON Schema cannot state (relation endpoints are concept labels of the same window, no duplicate concepts or relations, end_s > start_s, unique window_index, window lecture_id equal to the document's) are checked by extraction_schema.py next to this file.
title: ExtractionDocument

name.description: labeller name, or the model and configuration that produced the output

sample_manifest_sha256.description: gold files: sha256 of the sample manifest the labels were made against

window_index.description: window id as in the index stage's windows.json (kept non-empty windows, counted from 0)

end_s.description: seconds; start_s + 30, clipped to the audio duration

aliases.description: other names the speaker used: Roman Urdu/Hindi or Urdu-script surface forms, abbreviations, English variants

important.description: true only for an explicit teacher signal (ADR-0048, docs/labelling/m7_concepts.md)

cue.description: short English note of the cue when important is true; null otherwise

is_recap.description: F20, Exploratory: optional, not labelled in gold, not gated
